subject: Urgent demo request — APAC morning / after-hours coordination
messages:
From: Sandeep Rao <sandeep@acme-analytics.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: Aoi Tanaka <aoi.t@acme-analytics.jp>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 18:12:00 +09:00
Subject: Quick same-day ask — demo this morning (APAC)

Hi Connor,

Apologies for the short notice — can you run a quick live demo for us today at 10:00 SGT? Our product and infra teams (Aoi and I) are aligned to review Redwood's latency and routing features this morning. We're in APAC and understood from the onboarding call that Redwood can sometimes support after-hours demos for high-priority prospects.

Couple of constraints: we have an internal exec at 10:00 SGT who must sit in for the last 20 minutes, and our legal contact may pop questions about data residency and request a SOC2 artifact. Also, EU DST rolled last weekend and one of our stakeholders is in London — time conversions have already become messy.

If today truly won't work, we can take a recorded walk-through plus a short live Q&A at a time that works for your side, but preference is a live session this morning if possible.

— Sandeep
Head of Platform, Acme Analytics

Attachments: acme-questionnaire.docx (outlined questions), timezone-table.xlsx (referenced)

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2027 02:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick same-day ask — demo this morning (APAC)

Vanessa / Marissa — heads-up, Acme just asked for a same-day APAC-morning demo (see below). I'm happy to run it but it's outside normal hours for me (would be ~1:00am PDT). Can one of you either:

- Confirm whether we can offer an on-call APAC-friendly presenter (anyone in EU/APAC on shift), or
- If not, I'll do the session remotely late-night; need approval for after-hours credit/comp.

Two quick asks from Acme: SOC2 evidence and clarity on cross-region fallback behavior (they mentioned DST confusion). I attached our standard deck and a one-page SOC2 summary — feel free to edit before we send.

Options I'm proposing to them if we need to push:
1) Live demo at their 10:00 SGT with me joining (I can do it if we approve late-hour coverage).
2) 30m recorded product walkthrough + 30m live Q&A at 08:00 PDT today (less ideal for them).

I'll hold off replying to Sandeep until I hear from you both.

— Connor
Sr. Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2027 02:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick same-day ask — demo this morning (APAC)

Connor — thanks for the ping. I can take point on this one but will need an engineer on the line for latency/fallback questions. Mateo is on-call but he's not in this thread; can you loop him if needed?

I think we should offer two paths to keep the deal moving:
- Preferred: Live demo at 10:00 SGT (I can host the session — I have flexibility tonight). Connor, if you can join remotely that would be ideal for the deep-dive.
- Backup: Send a 20–25m recorded demo + schedule 30m live Q&A within 24 hours. That gives us time to attach SOC2 summary and the specific routing diagrams for cross-region fallback.

I'll draft the reply and propose those two options + ask which is their preferred one. If they insist on live this morning, I will confirm and create the bridge (we already have the enterprise bridge credentials).

— Vanessa
AE, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2027 03:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Quick same-day ask — demo this morning (APAC)

Thanks both — I'm available to join for the live Q&A for cadence-level questions and pricing. One note: if we run live at 10:00 SGT that is 18:00 GMT (UK just moved clocks for DST) and 01:00 PDT — confirm whether leadership wants to approve a late-hour attendance credit for Connor. If not, I can lead + Vanessa handle recording; Connor can join the Q&A chunk and we can record everything for the exec who wants only the last 20 minutes.

I also recommend we pre-send the SOC2 one-pager and a short PDF showing our recommended routing policies for cross-region failover so their legal/infra teams have something to review during the live call. I'll prepare the pricing sheet and send it along after Vanessa drafts the reply.

— Marissa
Director, Sales Engineering

Hi Sandeep / Aoi — thanks for the note and no problem on short notice. Two options so we can proceed whichever is easiest for you:

1) Live today at 10:00 SGT — Vanessa will host, Connor will join remotely for the deeper latency/routing bits, Marissa will be available for pricing/Q&A. We'll include an on-call engineer for fallback architecture if needed. We'll also pre-send a SOC2 one-pager and a short routing diagram PDF.

2) Recorded 20–25m walkthrough plus 30m live Q&A within 24 hours (we'll send the recording + docs now, then schedule the Q&A).

Please confirm which you prefer. If Live, we'll send a calendar invite (with the bridge and an attachment bundle) and a short pre-read.

Best,
